flags.finding: Written predictions exist for the graded selections listed on /cadence/predictions.html. Three sports carry no prediction because no selection in them reached medium confidence: golf (best outright 9.1%), greyhounds (best runner 50.4% off semi-final times alone) and Gaelic sports (no numeric strength input for both sides). Their strongest selections are still published with their prices and probabilities.

flags.item: This desk is another overlapping dashboard
flags.finding: The repository already holds more than thirty desks covering the same brief. Adding /cadence/ makes that thirty-eight, and the ledger desk's own repository review flags the overlap as a high-severity finding (RR-02). /cadence/ is published in its own namespace, states its capture window and its shortfalls, and does not claim to supersede any other layer; a single authoritative desk is an integration decision, not a claim this session can make unilaterally.

flags.item: The two rules in the brief intersect in 1.43 percentage points
flags.finding: 'High confidence above 70%' and 'price between -250 and +10000' intersect only in 70.00%-71.43%, because a fair -250 is 71.43%. The desk therefore publishes each selection's own fair price and marks whether it is in band, and additionally quotes an alternate line at the band ceiling wherever a continuous line ladder exists. It never relabels a shorter price as in band. Today 0 of the 22 high-confidence selections are inside the band on their natural price (all 22 sit above 71.43%), 8 clear it on an alternate line set at the ceiling, and 14 are genuinely outside because they are outright or money-line markets with no ladder.

flags.item: Nine start times converted on an inferred viewer zone
flags.finding: Six Cricket Australia rows and three Gallagher PREM rows were captured with 'viewer-local' clocks and no named zone. They are converted here as America/New_York because all nine land on orthodox venue starts under that reading (for example Newlands 10:30 SAST, Hagley Oval 20:00 NZDT, Leicester 15:05 BST) and on implausible ones otherwise. The inference is marked on every affected row (time_status viewer-zone-inferred) and needs review against the capturing browser's settings.

flags.item: 26 fixtures carry a calendar date only
flags.finding: EuroLeague game-centre times, WST site-clock times, URC 'local' times, two 'Followed by' tennis slots, one EuroLeague TBC, two golf moving days, two greyhound evening cards and the Formula 1 title outright have no resolvable clock basis in the stored captures. start_utc is left blank on those rows; only the date is asserted. Nothing was converted on a guess.

flags.item: OLBG event tables are not readable without a browser
flags.finding: Both OLBG pages re-read first-hand on 2026-10-23 (~21:30Z) returned the literal text 'No tips found' where the event table renders client-side, so a complete server-side OLBG event inventory still cannot be captured. Fixtures therefore come from each governing body and are joined to OLBG at sport level. Only 2 of 93 cadence fixtures carry an OLBG event id, and one of them (gaa-cork-psfc, id 14) reads like a sport id rather than an event id — that value needs review before any event-level join is trusted.

flags.item: One originated favourite disagrees with the only observed market price
flags.finding: NHL.com published DraftKings moneylines for the two 23 October NHL games when re-read on 2026-10-23: Montreal -170 at Chicago +142, and Tampa Bay +105 at Colorado -125. The first agrees in direction with this board (Montreal), the second does not: the board's Tampa Bay pick (72.4%) opposes the market favourite Colorado. The disagreement is disclosed, not smoothed over, and no bookmaker price was used as a pricing input anywhere on this board. Saturday prices were not yet published on NHL.com at read time, so all other observed-price cells stay blank.

flags.item: Saturday's NBA slate is not listed
flags.finding: NBA.com's calendar shows 8 games on 24 October and 7 on 25 October, but the fixture list itself failed to render for capture ('Sorry, something went wrong') on 2026-10-23. Those games are not listed here rather than sourced from a non-official listing. The 12 NBA rows on this board are the 23 October (US) games from the cadence capture, tipping from 23:00Z.

NHL.com's week strip shows further NHL slates inside the board's window (11 games on 27 October, 4 on 28 October, 11 on 29 October) that neither source capture holds with team inputs. They are omitted, not half-priced. The next refresh should capture them with a fresh standings snapshot.

flags.item: Two official NHL goal conventions meet on one board
flags.finding: The cadence rows price from the NHL standings feed, which counts the shootout-deciding goal; the added NHL rows price from the NHL stats-API team summary via the brief capture, which does not (for example Montreal 30 goals for in one feed, 28 in the other, over the same nine games). Every Ice Hockey row links the exact feed its inputs came from. Prices across the two groups are comparable in method but not identical in input convention.

Every unpriced fixture states its reason on its own row: missing comparative inputs (snooker ranking money, EHF Champions League strengths, darts order-of-merit pairs) in the cadence capture, and four added NHL fixtures involving clubs with no stored inputs (Florida, NY Islanders, Dallas, Winnipeg, Vancouver). Blank means blank: no price, probability or favourite was inferred for them.

flags.item: Only the NBA publishes a readable official availability feed here
flags.finding: NBA rows link the league's own 23 October injury report PDF. No other sport on this board has a readable official injury or team-news feed in the stored captures, and no written prediction on this board asserts that any individual player is injured or unavailable. Line-up-sensitive prices (NBA especially, on a one-to-two-game sample) should be re-checked against the linked report before use.

flags.item: Confidence is a probability band, not a calibrated strike rate
flags.finding: High means an originated probability of at least 70% from the stored inputs on the row (with the cadence tier caps preserved); medium at least 60%. The engines behind the two source captures have not been backtested on settled results inside this repository, NBA prices rest on a league-average prior after one or two games, and golf, greyhound and Gaelic rows carry low-confidence labels throughout. Treat the labels as a transparency device, not as a promise.
